data.content_ref: inline:The problem asks the respondent to argue for or against the specific claim comparing a decentralized network of small services to one large service with strictly more internal redundancy. SRC_001 never addresses this comparative claim at all: it defines a diagnostic signature but states no position on whether decentralization yields more resilience than a larger service with greater internal redundancy. Omitting the central argumentative claim the problem requires is a substantive failure, not merely a scope omission.
